creativeDirection.summary: FootyNet reads as a matchday-clear recruiting tool: a light, tidy product interface framed by a few deep pitch-green panels, confident Outfit headlines, and the product's own screens used as the imagery. The landing page carries the energy; the app stays calm and dense.

traits.quality: Clear: one primary action per view, a strong heading ladder, readable lists and rows
traits.boundary: not so sparse that status, filters or the next step disappear

traits.quality: Grounded in grassroots football: positions, leagues, seasons, trials and availability stated in plain words
traits.boundary: not elite-stadium glamour or betting-app urgency

traits.quality: Confident type: large tight Outfit headlines, often a bright clause followed by a muted one
traits.boundary: not all-caps shouting, monospace or condensed display type

traits.quality: Honest: approval, email confirmation and example data are stated plainly and labelled
traits.boundary: not invented statistics, testimonials, club logos or star ratings

creativeDirection.productiveTension: Calm, data-dense light product screens against a few deep pitch-green high-contrast panels with monumental type; the tool is quiet, the invitation is loud.

signatureDevice.description: Pitch-line panel: a deep pitch-green surface carrying faint white pitch markings (centre circle, halfway line, 48px mowing stripes) from the existing pitch-pattern utilities, used as the framing ground for the hero media field, the trust panel and the closing CTA.
invariants: Only on deep green (#052E22 to #03140F) surfaces, never on white and never on a card
Lines at 6-10% white, 1-2px strokes, mowing stripes at 48px
Geometry is a real pitch element (centre circle, halfway line, penalty-box corner), never random lines
At most three uses per page, and never inside dense app screens such as tables or chat
The centre circle sits behind an empty column, never under body text
Text on it is white or emerald-200; a primary button on it keeps the emerald-700 fill with white text plus a white outline for separation

creativeDirection.restraint: Emerald appears as the primary fill, the focus ring, the active and selected state, the availability status, and the deep-green signature panels. Cards do not each take their own colour, and decorative gradients stay out.
avoid: Emoji or hand-drawn SVG used as icons or as the logo
Gradient tiles, gradient text and decorative blobs
Shadow plus hover-lift on every card; static panels take a border or nothing
Three-equal-icon feature rows with no content inside them
Invented numbers, user counts, club logos, star ratings or testimonials, including inside any metrics-shaped or testimonial-shaped layout
All-caps body text or monospace UI copy
Neon lime, navy-and-cyan SaaS palettes, or the references' orange and black accents
White text on emerald-500 or emerald-600 fills
Hover-only information on job rows, cards or table rows
Hairline grid systems or card-edge rails that no reference actually shows

interfaceDirection: Spacing on a 4px base using 8/12/16/24/32/48/96/128; landing sections at 80-112px vertical padding on desktop and 64-80px on mobile, app pages at 24-32px. Widths: landing content max 1200px, hero and footer to 1440px with 40px gutters (24px on mobile), prose max 640px, FAQ column 72% on desktop and 84% at medium. Surfaces: slate-50 canvas, white cards with a 1px slate-200 border, slate-100 for grouped or selected rows, and deep pitch-green panels for the hero media field, the trust block, the role split and the closing CTA, keeping the references' light-dark-light sequence. Radius: 8px controls, 12px cards and vignettes, 16-24px landing media frames, full pill only for status badges and the closing CTA button. Shadows: shadow-lift on vignette cards that sit on green, shadow-card on interactive cards, borders alone on static panels. Cards group a real unit (a job ad, an applicant, a step with its own interface, a feature with a live example); ordinary prose is never boxed, and the trust list stays open editorial text on the green panel as in the ollef-style values block. Media frames hold native product interface, not photography: the karo hero keeps a narrow left rail beside a dominant stacked media field; lexedge-style cards keep a media area above a bottom meta bar; fabrica and nubo showreel frames keep one large rounded centred frame; mello keeps one dominant tile beside smaller ones. Controls: 48px landing and 40px app height, primary emerald-700 with white text and emerald-800 hover, secondary white with a slate-300 border, ghost links emerald-700 on light and emerald-300 on dark with an always-on underline on dark panels. Focus is a 3px emerald-600 ring with a 2px offset (emerald-300 on dark). Every link, anchor, icon button and wordmark gets padding or min-height so its hit area reaches 44x44px even when the visible text is smaller, and links inside flex rows carry a min-width or full-width so they cannot collapse. Active nav: emerald-800 text with a 2px emerald-700 underline. Tables: 48px rows, sticky header, no zebra, slate-50 row hover, emerald-800 on emerald-50 status pills. Empty states: a lucide icon in a 48px emerald-50 circle, one explaining line, one primary action.

imageDirection.summary: The product is the imagery. Every media frame holds FootyNet's own interface built in HTML and CSS, placed in the reference's frame geometry, with a visible example-data label.
subjects: Job board with three open positions, each showing club initials, league, city, training days and an Apply action
Applicant list with avatar initials, position, preferred foot, age and a Message action
Player profile with avatar, position, foot, city, availability badge and a career timeline
Job-ad form with filled position, league and city fields and a Publish action
Club approval status with a three-step progress (registered, email confirmed, admin review)
Chat thread with a club bubble, an emerald player bubble and a message input
Availability badges and an applicants-per-day bar chart drawn from example values
Register role chooser showing the player and club options with the player card selected
imageDirection.treatment: White 12-24px-radius cards with shadow-lift, set inside deep pitch-green or emerald-50 frames at fixed aspect ratios so nothing shifts while fonts load. Vignettes are inert and aria-hidden with a visually hidden sentence describing them, and each frame carries a visible 'Example data' / 'Primjer podataka' tag. Dark frames keep body text at white or white/70% and never place small text over the pitch markings.
avoid: Stock or generated photography of people, pitches or equipment
Decorative SVG illustrations, abstract shapes, sonar graphics or schematic diagrams used as filler
Rasterized screenshots of interfaces that can be built natively
Fake device mockups with glare or perspective
Identifiable real club crests, kits, sponsors or player names
Charts or counters presenting unverified numbers as real metrics

motionDirection.summary: Visible, purposeful motion: the hero assembles on load, later sections each reveal once in their own way as they enter, and controls give crisp direct feedback. Everything animates opacity and transform only, runs once, and renders final under reduced motion.
principles: Hero entrance establishes reading order; trigger: page load; the rail wordmark, statement, link groups and Register rise 16px and fade with an 80ms stagger while each media frame fades its green ground and lifts its white vignette card 20px; 600-750ms; strong ease-out cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)

Hero board rows explain content inside an already-moving frame; trigger: load, 420ms after the frame; the three job rows fade in at 70ms intervals with opacity only, so no transform nests inside the card's own entrance; 500ms; ease-out

Player step tiles explain a sequence; trigger: each tile group entering the viewport once via IntersectionObserver at threshold 0 with a positive bottom rootMargin, then unobserved; tiles rise 20px and fade with a 90ms stagger and the inner vignette follows its ground; 600-620ms; ease-out

Club cards introduce paired steps; trigger: each card row entering once; the two cards in a row fade and rise 20px 80ms apart while the inner vignette scales from 0.96 to 1, keeping the title and the glass meta bar readable throughout; 600ms; ease-out

Product preview assembles the product; trigger: the bento group entering once; the large dark card fades and rises 12px first, then the job-ad and right-hand cards slide 20px in from the right with the total stagger capped at 240ms, after which the chart bars grow from scaleY 0.2 to 1 anchored at the bottom; 500-650ms; ease-out

Trust and feature lists clarify structure; trigger: each list item or card entering once; items fade and rise 12px in sequence at 70-90ms while the static label and rule stay put; 450-560ms; gentle ease-out cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)

Role choice shows a decision being made; trigger: the choice panel entering once; the panel fades, its two option cards rise 12px in sequence, then the selected card's border settles from slate-300 to emerald-700; 300ms for the border inside a 650ms panel entrance; ease-out

Direct feedback confirms interaction; trigger: hover on fine pointers, focus and press on buttons, nav links, cards and rows; background-color, border-color, box-shadow and a 1px translateY on named properties only; 120-200ms; ease-out

Disclosure keeps continuity; trigger: click or keyboard toggle on a FAQ row, the mobile menu or a modal; the panel animates grid-template-rows 0fr to 1fr with an opacity fade while the Plus rotates 45deg or the chevron flips, and a modal rises 8px on the dialog itself, never on an ancestor of a fixed element; 200-260ms; ease-in-out

Reduced motion and script failure stay readable; trigger: prefers-reduced-motion or no JavaScript; every section renders in its final visible state, observers disconnect, owned animations cancel and only colour feedback remains; 0ms; no easing
avoid: transition: all
Scale-from-zero or blur-in entrances
The same fade-up applied to every section
Reveals that reset on scroll-out, resize or rerender
A global opacity:0 reveal class that hides content when scripting fails
Transforms on ancestors of the sticky top bar, the mobile sheet or a modal
Nested reveal transforms inside an element that is already animating
Scroll-jacking, parallax or perpetual floating
Large clip-path, filter or blur animations
Hover-only information, and any motion inside dense app tables or chat beyond feedback

voice.summary: Direct, warm and practical, like a good club secretary: short sentences, real football words (trial, squad, position, season, league, availability), a clear next step, and the same meaning in Croatian and English. Headlines pair a plain statement with a muted second clause.
avoid: Hype words such as revolutionary, ultimate or game-changing
Invented numbers, guarantees of signing, or success claims
Corporate jargon and startup slang
Stacked puns or a joke in every heading
All-caps sentences outside the single brand label
Copy whose meaning differs between en and hr
Internal notes such as pending, to be supplied or not connected in visible copy
